sql.cursor: SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "value" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 AND ("orders"."CreatedAt" > @p2 OR ("orders"."CreatedAt" = @p3 AND ("orders"."TenantId" > @p4 OR ("orders"."TenantId" = @p5 AND "orders"."Id" > @p6)))) ORDER BY "orders"."CreatedAt" ASC NULLS LAST, "orders"."TenantId" ASC NULLS LAST, "orders"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p7
sql.offset: SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "value" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 ORDER BY "orders"."CreatedAt" ASC NULLS LAST, "orders"."TenantId" ASC NULLS LAST, "orders"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p2 OFFSET @p3
sql.exists: SELECT "customers"."Id" AS "value" FROM "customers" WHERE EXISTS(SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "value" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 AND "orders"."Id" >= @p2) ORDER BY "customers"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p3
sql.in-subquery: SELECT "customers"."Id" AS "value" FROM "customers" WHERE "customers"."Id" IN (SELECT "orders"."CustomerId" AS "value" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 AND "orders"."Id" > @p2) ORDER BY "customers"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p3
sql.cte: WITH "selected_order_ids" ("Id") AS (SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "Id" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 AND "orders"."Id" > @p2) SELECT "selected_order_ids"."Id" AS "value" FROM "selected_order_ids" ORDER BY "selected_order_ids"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p3
sql.window: SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "Id", (ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY "orders"."CustomerId" ORDER BY "orders"."CreatedAt" ASC NULLS LAST, "orders"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST )) AS "Rank" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 ORDER BY "orders"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p2
sql.union-all: WITH "selected_order_ids" ("Id") AS (SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "Id" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 AND "orders"."Id" <= @p2 UNION ALL SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "Id" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p3 AND ("orders"."Id" >= @p4 AND "orders"."Id" <= @p5)) SELECT "selected_order_ids"."Id" AS "value" FROM "selected_order_ids" ORDER BY "selected_order_ids"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST

sql.intersect: WITH "selected_order_ids" ("Id") AS (SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "Id" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 AND "orders"."Id" <= @p2 INTERSECT SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "Id" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p3 AND ("orders"."Id" >= @p4 AND "orders"."Id" <= @p5)) SELECT "selected_order_ids"."Id" AS "value" FROM "selected_order_ids" ORDER BY "selected_order_ids"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST

sql.three-join: SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "OrderId", "customer"."Name" AS "Name", "line"."Product" AS "Product", "line"."Quantity" AS "Quantity" FROM "orders" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "customer" ON "orders"."CustomerId" = "customer"."Id" INNER JOIN "order_lines" AS "line" ON "orders"."TenantId" = "line"."TenantId" AND "orders"."Id" = "line"."OrderId" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 ORDER BY "orders"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST, "line"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p2
sql.anti-association: SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "value" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 AND (NOT "orders"."Id" IN (SELECT "order_lines"."OrderId" AS "value" FROM "order_lines" WHERE "order_lines"."TenantId" = @p2 AND "order_lines"."Quantity" >= @p3)) ORDER BY "orders"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p4
sql.nullable-order: SELECT "orders"."Id" AS "value" FROM "orders" WHERE "orders"."TenantId" = @p1 ORDER BY "orders"."CustomerId" ASC NULLS FIRST, "orders"."Id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT @p2
